001_remove_shield.notes: Full canvas and fist close-up reviewed after neutral checker-fringe cleanup; no shield remains, hand is continuous. Outside-mask pixels preserved exactly.

002_remove_sword.notes: Sword removed but diagonal skirt/cloth color and fold seams remain; cape has a pommel-area seam. Not production approved. Continue independent cape removal for final body review only, never formal extraction.

003_remove_cape.notes: Cape removal candidate reviewed at full canvas and neck/shoulder detail. AI introduced a raised collar whose design is not established by visible source armor; edge matte and source-to-completion continuity require correction. Not approved.

complete_body.notes: STOP_ART_PIPELINE. Double hands/legs exist and equipment is removed, but diagonal skirt folds/color seam and local matte artifacts remain. The added raised collar requires correction to conservative continuation of the visible source design. Do not split this body or use it in Godot.

complete_body_v2.notes: Ten visual checks pass: skirt seam and raised collar resolved, no obvious identity drift. Production gate FAIL because the supplied 1024x1536 PNG is RGB with an opaque black background and no alpha channel. Candidate bytes preserved; no AI or downstream stages run.

complete_body_v2_rgba.reviewer: Codex visual inspection of white/grey/checker composites and eight edge regions
complete_body_v2_rgba.notes: Format and exact RGB preservation pass. Alpha matte fails visual review: irregular black fringe and speckles remain around crest, shoulder and soles. No full Body gate or parts allowed. Original RGB visual approval is preserved.

complete_body_v3.reviewer: Codex visual inspection: 4 backgrounds, 11 matched 4x detail strips and marked target sheet
complete_body_v3.notes: Numeric format, trimap, fractional Alpha and opaque RGB checks pass. Local black protrusions remain on plume, shoulder, far shin and soles. Only local Alpha touchup remains; no global retuning, parts or Godot approval.

complete_body_combat.reviewer: Codex visual inspection of native 660x830 sheet
complete_body_combat.notes: Reviewed all six native-size white/gray composites. Dark outlines are continuous and intentional; no conspicuous detached dots, sole blocks or halo at target heights. No zoomed source-pixel defects used to fail this combat review. Battlefield image unavailable.
